We all need a chance to change our lives! The story follows Miko Kurono, who began her dream career as a livestreamer under the name "Necronomico" after graduating middle school. Amidst spending her days with childhood friend Mayu Mayusaka and rival Kanna Kagurazaka, she's introduced to a new VR game project!?

Upon encountering the game, the girls start pursuing the 'irreplacable now'.

(Source: Official site, translated)

Comedy spin-off to the Araiguma Rascal (Raccoon Rascal) anime.

The story is set around five employees working hard in the lesser Tama branch of a secret society aiming for world domination called the Calcal Group: an aspirational new recruit, a polite but self-conscious superior, a modern guy with a cold attitude to everything, a hotheaded but kind senior employee and a handsome older man leading the pack.

(Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)

Though the two girls attend separate high schools, they meet up at a shopping center’s food court almost every day. Take a little peek at the laid-back afternoons Wada and Yamamoto share as they reflect on the ups and downs of high school life together.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Arc returns! After waking to find he's become a Skeleton Knight in his favorite fantasy video game, Arc, Ariane, Chiyome, and Ponta band together to take on evil. Before Arc's search for a cure to his skeletal condition continues, he must face a dogmatic leader, Count Hilk, to free oppressed elves and beasts. A new chapter begins as the Skeleton Knight fights to make his new world a better place.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

When superstar adventurer Dennis gets booted from the world’s strongest party, he teams up with runaway Atelier to serve up his true passion—delicious cuisine. But this not-so-average eatery has not-so-average patrons. Dennis will battle his quirky customers’ troubles with his trusty butcher knife and wok. Visit Adventurer’s Restaurant and fill up your heart and stomach!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Kannawa has a secret: Even though she has a reputation in the office as intense, strict, and scary, she’s actually just…awkward. So, when she learns she has to train Kamegawa, the cute, nerdy newbie, she’s at a complete loss! Can this awkward senpai figure out how to handle her budding feelings?!

60543.description:
While the mission to exorcise Jin "Jiji" Enjouji's family home is underway, things are not going as expected. Momo Ayase narrowly evades an attempted abduction while Ken "Okarun" Takakura and Jiji are ambushed by the Kitou family—the unsettling landlords of the cursed estate. The trio's efforts threaten the foundation of this enigmatic town shrouded in legends and mysteries.

As Momo, Okarun, and Jiji are drawn deeper into the maze of folklore and supernatural entities, they must each utilize their unique powers if they want to survive and unravel the secrets of the uncanny town.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Note: Worldwide premiere of Episodes 1-3 titled as DAN DA DAN: EVIL EYE before the Japanese premiere was pre-screened in advance in theaters on June 6, 2025 in North America by GKIDS Films and June 7 and 8 in Europe by Piece of Magic Entertainment and Animation Digital Network.

What will become of the fate of Ne Zha and Ao Bing?

Magical Girls - they're strong, cool and agile. Everyone wants to be one. Popular and high-paying, it's a respectable line of work. Kana Sakuragi, Hitomi Koshigaya, and the members of Magilumiere work to promote the Alice System, which allows Magical Girls to order the magic they need to battle. But behind the scenes, factions seeking to ease magic regulations and make a profit are moving...

(Source: Prime Video)

60553.description:
Yuka spends her days in an uncomfortable classroom, eating lunch alone, and thinking only about the time she would sex stream at home. One day, she finds what appears to be a love letter in her shoe locker! When she opens it with high hopes, she finds a screenshot of her latest stream and a letter calling her... The man who called her uses the fact that her stream was exposed as a pretext to pressure her into sex streaming in front of him. Rather than being assaulted... she does as he says and does it until she climaxes, but the man assaults Yuka right after she has climaxed!?

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)

60560.description:
Wang Ling, a dry noodle-loving immortal king, now faces his greatest challenge yet! With a novelist dad, a mysterious mom, a brand-new little sister, and the sudden arrival of a powerful little sister, Wang Nuan, the Wang family’s ordinary life is turned upside down. And figuring out how to be a good older brother becomes the latest challenge for the mighty immortal king. Surprisingly, Wang Nuan’s extraordinary power doesn’t shock the Wang family. Wang Ling starts early, teaching his sister to control her immense abilities. But her power catches the attention of the sinister organization Ye Kui and Bai Zhe, a top-tier prisoner from Enchanted Prison. Faced with threats from evil cultivators, Wang Ling makes a decision that defies tradition: he’ll take his sister along to teach these villains a lesson! This season, join the immortal king and his little sister as they dive into a life filled with humor and unexpected adventures!

(Source: Bilibili)

60563.description: After a difficult upbringing, Qingchen's life takes a drastic turn when a mysterious countdown emerges on his arm. He is taken to Prison No. 18, a dangerous parallel universe, when it reaches zero. He overcomes severe adversity and gains the respect of the demigod Li Shutong by using his cunning and bravery. He then becomes his disciple and embarks on a journey of genuine transformation.

60564.description:
Brace yourselves for the hilarious romantic comedy's return! What antics and arguments will Ranma and Akane get into next?

(Source: Netflix Anime)

60565.description: The down-and-out fairy Yao Ji who traveled through time and space! The young Liu Ling who needed to see himself found the magic stone. The two reached a cooperation and found the concubines with special skills to teach them. Liu Ling successfully started his journey to the East Palace. As they spent time together day and night, he suddenly found that he had different feelings for Yao Ji...
synonyms: Everything is Fine with the Emperor

60566.description:
When Wen Yifan returned to her hometown for work, she unexpectedly ran into the rumored "First-Class Handsome Guy" at a bar. However, she soon discovered that he was Sang Yan, someone she had hurt and rejected in high school. In a twist of fate, these two individuals who could never get along found themselves constantly crossing paths. They even ended up renting the same unit by chance and becoming housemates. With unspoken feelings buried deep within, strong emotions begin to stir...

Let's see how Sang Yan, the "Peak Ideal Boyfriend," interprets and expresses his profound affection and sweet love!

(Source: INKR)

60567.description:
Prince Li Jiancheng and his supporters were put to death following the Xuanwu Gate Incident, and all six of his sons—aside from one who passed away too soon—were implicated. Only the records of "the second daughter Wenxi County Lady Li Wanshun, courtesy name Wangniang, married Liu Yingdao" and "eldest daughter Li" remained in the historical record, nevertheless.

The Yongning Princess Li Changge, whose parents had an unexplained and perplexing relationship with Li Shimin, emerged in these Li's mysteries. After learning of her mother's suicide and her father's murder following the Xuanwu Gate Incident, Changge fled the palace with bitterness and assumed the identity of a man in order to conceal her identity and bring troops back to Chang'an to exact revenge on her parents.
synonyms: The Legend of Princess Chang Ge
สตรีหาญฉางเกอ

60568.description:
In order to return to the past, Guan Chao searches for the "Burning Stone", the energy source that can activate the Time Gun, but unexpectedly falls into the Memory Administration Bureau. To return to reality, Guan Chao teams up with memory administrators such as Fang Tang and Bai Zhong to recover the BUG Beings in the memory layers level by level. As the battles conclude one after another, what Guan Chao must face is...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

60569.description:
The second season of Zhongguo Qitan.

A collection of 9 short movies about Chinese folklore "monsters".

60570.description:
In this thrilling continuation, former Wilderness Hunter Commander Marc has transformed into a blood-stained monster who destroys lighthouses. Guided by the enigmatic Bai Yuekui, he embarks on a new mission. The arrival of survivors on the ground reveals that the lighthouse isn't humanity's final refuge. Facing adversity, they harness their innate abilities to combat the Mana ecosystem. Bai Yuekui's past intricately links to Mark's origins and the apocalypse's truth.
Meanwhile, the colossal brain on the lighthouse awakens, the old shadows linger, and a new crisis emerges. As unprecedented disasters loom, where will the two human factions ultimately head?

(Source: BiliBili, translated)

60571.description:
After traveling to what appears to be a true Tang Dynasty world, the main character Ning Que discovers that it is actually a perilous agricultural world. He first believed that he could become superior and live a luxurious lifestyle, but he discovers that he lacks cultivation skills. He was also persecuted for thousands of miles and saw his entire family massacred when he was four years old. He discovered the baby Sangsang while he was running away from death and picked up a black umbrella in a sea of blood and dead. He discovered the will to live in despair. He takes the large black umbrella and Sangsang and launches an exciting counterattack, refusing to submit to fate.

(Source: bilibili)

60572.description:
Fan Lingxiao, a gifted spirit pet master, was ambushed in the A-level sect promotion competition and devoured by his own spirit, Kun. When he woke up, he found himself reincarnated into a young man named "Liu Fengmang" and imprisoned in the White Mansion. His sect, Lingxiao Pavilion, was also in dire straits. In order to find out the truth about the backlash of the spirit Kun and revive the sect, Fan Lingxiao takes his existing spirit pets and embarks on a new adventure with Gu Ling, Cheng Xi, and Yue Tong.

(Source: Bilibili)

Note: The first episode has a runtime of 36 minutes.
synonyms: 転生宗主の覇道譚 ～すべてを呑み込むサカナと這い上がる～

title.romaji: Kun Tun Tianxia Zhi Zhang Men Guilai

60574.description: The new art of cultivating immortals with technology is rising, while the old art of cultivating immortals that has been passed down for thousands of years is gradually declining. Wang Xuan, a genius boy of the old art, accidentally joins the mysterious organization Secret Road. He seizes treasures, fights new art, fights immortals, and in a series of thrilling adventures, he peeks into the big secrets hidden in the old art. In order to cope with the huge crisis that is about to come, Wang Xuan does not hesitate to go deep into the universe and challenge the limits of his growth.
synonyms: The Other Side of Deep Space
เหนือห้วงอวกาศ

60575.description: A short film by Shinichi Suzuki.

60578.description:
In the high tower world where money is paramount, follow the grassroots male protagonist to climb to the top of the tower and realize his counterattack plan of becoming rich in 100 days!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: The Man From Dao Xiang Cun
title.romaji: Jian Wang 3: Shen Jianxin de 365 Tian

60580.description:
In a world where warriors are respected, Shi Mu's fate seems destined to be different. As the adopted son of an aristocratic family, he is forced to embark on the road of a warrior to find the truth and redeem himself. From the four halls of Fengcheng to the struggle between sects, interests are entangled, and powerful enemies lurk. Every challenge makes Shi Mu more determined. In the end, Shi Mu realizes the power of his bloodline, which not only changes his own destiny, but also affects the future of many people.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

60581.description:
Hao Ren was a typical young man from a small city who was barely making ends meet while living in an old house. However, via a strange turn of events, he becomes a "universe police officer." A problem is developing in his domain, the Dream Plane Universe, as he struggles to oversee a home inhabited by strange, non-human residents that his enigmatic superiors have assigned him.

As he investigates further, Hao Ren discovers a link between the remnants of a vanished civilization in the Dream Plane and the strange species on Earth. Hao Ren quickly learns that slacking off is no longer an option when long-buried horrors, fallen deities, and ancient cataclysms reappear.
synonyms: The new chronicles of extraordinary Beings: Preface

title.romaji: Xin Yichang Shengwu Jianwen Lu: Xu

60582.description:
Ell, the strongest dragon in the Demon Realm, wants one thing: to die, so he can relax in the afterlife. Unfortunately, that’s easier said than done. After accidentally offing yet another hero, Ell has an idea. If no warrior can slay him, he’ll just raise one who can! After meeting the magician Lafi, Ell begins raising her son, Dino, for this purpose. So begins his hardest quest yet, parenthood.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

60583.description:
The young warrior Yun Qingyan disappeared from the world three years ago, but he was actually drawn into the fairy world for three thousand years! With his extraordinary talent, he became the Yun Emperor, one of the ten great fairy emperors. However, because he was tired of the intrigues in the fairy world and missed his family, he decided to return to the human world at all costs. Upon return to the human world, his parents and sister strangely disappeared, and due to an incident whilst traveling from the fairy world to the human world, he lost his magic weapon and his cultivation became almost zero. Major forces took this opportunity to hunt him down. The fairy emperor became the target of public criticism, and his family was in danger! Yun Qingyan relied on his extraordinary fairy emperor talent to refine pills and array formations, study and practice, and overwhelm his enemies. He embarked on an adventure to revive his family, find his relatives, and rectify the mortal world.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

60586.description:
Some people developed extraordinary talents after waves of spiritual energy were released by enigmatic "Spiritual Ruins Gates" that arose all over the planet twenty years ago. Spirit Warriors, who possessed supernatural abilities, were the name given to these talented individuals.

Particularly after demonstrating their unparalleled strength during the devastating Beast Tide Disaster, the uncommon "Space series" fighters were the most elite among them.

From his early years, Jiang Nan, an orphan who grew up in Jiangcheng, Lingzhou, had aspirations of becoming the greatest Spirit Warrior. He awakens as Lingzhou's second-ever space-type warrior at the age of sixteen, with the rarest and most potent ability of all.

Here's where his incredible journey starts...
synonyms: Open a Street Stall and Sell Vigorously

60587.description:
This is the tale of a well-known cartoonist who rose to fame thanks to his comic book.B.K. But after several years, he ran out of ideas and had to rely solely on abandoning his characters in order to draw attention. He was drawn into the realm of B. King as Wang Xiaoming after receiving an enigmatic phone call one day. As a result, Wang Xiaoming, who now possesses the ideas of the "creator," sets out on a fantastical journey that might be summed up as "God's shortcut, one step to heaven."

(Source: Bilibili TV)

60588.description:
Following a decline in the amount of monster movies created, Meng Qi, a director who is obsessed with the monster movie genre, becomes unsure about his persistence—he never expected that one day an actual monster would appear in front of him! In order to fulfill his dream, Meng Qi decides to cooperate with the demon girl Liya and help her shoot a demon themed movie. However, as the shooting progresses, Meng Qi discovers that things in the other world are closely related to him...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Kai Pai La! Guaishou Da Dianying

60589.description:
Fifty years ago, the martial arts world was suddenly invaded by the “Hun Dun”. Murong Qiong established the Demon Sect to resist it, but they couldn’t manage to win despite arduous battles. The Divine Messenger Yi Zhihua descended and taught everyone the cultivation method of demonization, and they finally managed to defeat the Hun Dun. However, after the Divine Messenger left, the cultivation method went out of control as it spread in the martial arts world. Disappointed, Murong Qiong retired and his subordinate Yu Huabing seized the power, improved the cultivation method, and created an era of Punk True Qi, making the martial arts world thrive. But the price of prosperity was that all the cultivators became “Shang Gong fanatics”. Dongfang Sheng, harboring an idealistic and sincere aspiration, found Murong Qiong secluded in the Westward Restaurant. He hoped that Murong Qiong would assist in restoring the glory of the martial arts world.The comical story thus began...

(Source: BilibiliTV)

60591.description:
Ji Miaomiao, a young woman just starting her career, is betrayed by a friend and left with a mountain of debt. While fleeing from ruthless debt collectors, she accidentally falls from a building. On the brink of death, a mysterious figure transforms her into a cat.

By a twist of fate, she ends up being adopted—by none other than her own boss, Lu Chengze. Thus begins her strange and magical 100-day life... as a cat.

(Source: Bilibili)

60592.description:
Luo Li has been trapped in the soulless Yinzhou Continent since he was a child and became the number one killer of Tianjue Killing Hall. His father, Master Ciyun, sacrificed himself to buy Luo Li a chance to escape from Yinzhou and go to Zhongtian Main World to find the true way to cultivate immortality.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Da Dao Du Xing: Die Long Bian

60593.description:
Kouichi Haimawari is a dull college student who aspires to be a hero but has given up on his dream. Although 80% of the world’s population has superhuman powers called Quirks, few are chosen to become heroes and protect people. Everything changes for Kouichi when he and Pop☆Step are saved by the vigilante Knuckleduster and get recruited to become vigilantes themselves!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
